_purpose: Pins each canonical aircraft's physics configuration to its visual asset. A flight of a pinned variant is refused if any pinned value differs. Parameter-file hashes are taken with line endings normalised to LF, so Windows (CRLF) and Linux checkouts agree.

phantom-a10d.name: Phantom A10-D · A10-C + transition ECU · test aircraft
phantom-a10d.note: Test aircraft, not promoted (inputs/phantom_test_variants_v1.json): the A10-C (phantom-a10c) plus the transition ECU overlay transition_ecu_v1, on the A10-C airframe and visual. Pinned so that a changed overlay or visual is refused, never flown under this name. The A10-C itself is unchanged and is not pinned here.
